requestBody.description: User data to add to Parchment

201.description: User created. Read the `code` field — a provider record may not have been created.

Success.summary: User created and provider record created

Provider not found.summary: User created, but NO provider record — the user cannot prescribe

value.message: User created but provider not found

data.warning: User created successfully but provider search failed

Provider already exists.summary: User created, but the HPI-I is already held by another active provider in this organization

value.message: User created but provider already exists

data.warning: User created successfully but provider creation failed

400.description: Bad Request - the identity provider rejected the user parameters (for example, a malformed email)

401.description: Unauthorized - authentication required, token invalid, or the token lacks the create:user scope

403.description: Forbidden - rejected by the API gateway, or the user creation service refused access

404.description: Not Found - platform configuration error; contact Parchment support with the requestId

409.description: Conflict - a Parchment user already exists with this email address. Email addresses are unique across the whole platform, not per organization.

429.description: Too Many Requests - rate limited by the identity provider; retry with back-off

500.description: Internal Server Error - unexpected error, including a request body that is not valid JSON

CustomDrugInput.description: Custom drug fields supplied by a partner when creating a drug.

quantity.description: String or number; coerced to string

max_repeats.description: String or number; coerced to string

poison_class.description: Schedule with the S prefix, S2 to S9. A bare digit is rejected.

custom_product_id.description: Your own identifier for this drug. Never generated by Parchment. Not checked for uniqueness.

CustomDrugUpdate.description: Partial custom drug fields to update. Send only the fields to change.

poison_class.description: Schedule with the S prefix, S2 to S9. A bare digit is rejected.

custom_product_id.description: Your own identifier for this drug. Never generated by Parchment. Not checked for uniqueness.

ExternalCustomDrug.description: A custom drug as exposed to partners. custom_drug_id is the unique identifier used to prefill the prescription form.

custom_drug_id.description: Unique identifier for the custom drug

success.description: Indicates if the request was successful

count.description: Number of items in current response

lastKey.description: Opaque cursor for fetching the next page. Use this value as the lastKey query parameter for the next request. If null, no more pages are available

success.description: Indicates if the request was successful

code.description: Machine-readable operation code identifying the error

detail.example: There were some problems with your input.

instance.description: URI reference to the specific occurrence

ihi_number.description: 16-digit Individual Healthcare Identifier (IHI). If omitted, Parchment will attempt to fetch it from the HI Service.

date_of_birth.description: Patient's date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format

phone.description: Patient's Australian mobile number (optional). Must be a valid Australian mobile (04xxxxxxxx or 05xxxxxxxx), digits only. International format with +61 or 61 prefix is also accepted. Landlines are rejected. A mobile number can be used for IHI lookup against the Healthcare Identifiers Service.

partner_patient_id.description: Partner's unique identifier for the patient

partner_id.description: Your Parchment-assigned partner identifier (lowercase slug, e.g. 'tacklit'). Parchment registers this value during partner onboarding — requests with an unregistered value are rejected with a 422 validation error. Contact Parchment before go-live to have your identifier registered.

external_patient_id.description: Partner's unique identifier for the patient

parchment_patient_id.description: Parchment's unique identifier for the patient

url.description: URL to access the patient in Parchment portal

IHIPrecheckData.description: Codified IHI precheck result. The IHI number itself is never returned.

outcome.description: The precheck result. ihi_found: a live HI Service search matched an IHI. no_match: the search ran but no IHI resolved (creation still succeeds, without an IHI). insufficient_data: no search path can run with the supplied fields. already_exists: a patient with this partner_patient_id already exists for the organization. organization_not_ready: the organization has no HPI-O configured. hi_service_error: the HI Service could not be reached.

create_would_succeed.description: Whether an identical create request would succeed now. True for already_exists and no_match; false for PROVISIONAL/UNVERIFIED records, organization_not_ready, hi_service_error and insufficient_data without any identifier.

ihi_check_passed.description: True only for an ACTIVE + VERIFIED IHI. Absent when no search ran.

searched_path.description: Identifier that matched, or the last one tried on no_match. Identifiers are tried in priority order: IHI, Medicare, DVA, mobile, email, Australian address, international address.

failed_paths.description: Identifiers tried before searched_path. Absent when the first matched.

has_ihi.description: already_exists only: whether the stored patient holds an IHI

parchment_patient_id.description: already_exists only: the Parchment patient ID

search_paths.description: insufficient_data only: per-path list of the request fields that would unlock each search path

success.description: Always true for a completed precheck

message.description: Human-readable summary naming the matched identifier. Informational only.
message.example: IHI found using mobile number (no record found using Medicare number)

code.description: Always SUCCESS. Branch on data.outcome instead.

date_of_birth.description: User's date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format (required if role includes 'provider' or 'rx_queue_manager')

sex.description: User's sex — M (male), F (female), I (indeterminate), N (not stated). Required if access_roles includes 'provider' or 'rx_queue_manager'.

phone.description: Contact phone number. Not validated by the API — send an Australian number (04xxxxxxxx, 0[2378]xxxxxxxx, or +61 prefixed) so it prints correctly on prescriptions.

access_roles.description: Roles for the user. Omitted: the user gets member only. provider and rx_queue_manager require date_of_birth, sex, hpii_number and qualifications; provider also requires prescriber_type, and prescriber_number unless prescriber_type is T.

hpii_number.description: Healthcare Provider Individual Identifier, 16 digits with a valid check digit. Required when access_roles includes provider or rx_queue_manager. Verified against the HI Service together with given_name, family_name, date_of_birth and sex.

prescriber_type.description: Prescriber type — M (medical practitioner), E (optometrist), U (nurse), F (midwife), D (dentist), V (veterinarian), T (podiatrist), C (pharmacist). Required if access_roles includes 'provider'.

prescriber_number.description: Prescriber number (required if role includes 'provider' and prescriber_type is not 'T')

qualifications.description: Professional qualifications. Required when access_roles includes provider or rx_queue_manager.

ahpra_number.description: AHPRA registration number: a 3-letter profession prefix followed by 10 digits (13 characters).

erx_entity_id.description: eRx Entity ID — exactly 5 alphanumeric characters.

user_id.description: Parchment's unique identifier for the user. This is the only identifier returned.

warning.description: Present only on a partial success. Names the follow-up step that did not complete. Read the top-level `code` field to decide what to do.
warning.example: User created successfully but provider search failed

code.description: Result code. USER_CREATED means the provider record exists. Any USER_CREATED_PROVIDER_* code means there is no provider record and the user cannot prescribe.

access_roles.description: Array of roles to assign to the user

items.description: Valid user roles. Note: owner, support, and member roles cannot be assigned via API.

user_id.description: Parchment's unique identifier for the user

access_roles.description: Updated array of roles assigned to user

grantType.description: Type of grant for OAuth2 authentication

scope.description: List of permission scopes being requested

status.description: Current status of the prescription. `Error` indicates the prescription failed processing; see the `error` object for details.

delivery.description: How and where this prescription's current version was electronically delivered. Reflects the CURRENT version only — a reissue overwrites it. To capture delivery history (e.g. an original send followed by reissues to different addresses), fetch this endpoint in response to each prescription webhook notification (`prescription.created`, `prescription.reissued`); each fetch returns the delivery state as at that event.

recipient_type.description: Whether the script was sent to a pharmacy or directly to the patient.

destination.description: The exact email address or phone number the script was sent to.

pharmacy.description: Identity of the selected pharmacy. Present only when recipient_type is PHARMACY; the address is in `destination`.

pharmacy_id.description: The internal Parchment record ID of the pharmacy.

custom_drug_details.description: Details of a custom (non-catalogue) drug, when the prescribed item is a custom drug.

error.description: Present only when `status` is `Error`; omitted otherwise.

description.description: Human-readable description of the error that occurred during processing.

title.description: Prescriber's title (e.g. Dr). Present on the per-prescription prescriber; omitted on the deprecated top-level prescriber.

user_id.description: Parchment user identifier of the prescriber. Use this to map the prescriber to a user/provider in your system.

prescriber.description: Deprecated. Use `prescriptions[].prescriber` instead. This field is kept for backwards compatibility and will be removed in a future release.

UpdatePatient.description: Patient update request - all fields are optional

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format

sex.description: Sex: M (Male), F (Female), I (Indeterminate), N (Not stated)

ihi_number.description: 16-digit Individual Healthcare Identifier (IHI). Must be exactly 16 numeric digits.

medicare_valid_to.description: Medicare expiry date in YYYY-MM-DD format

dva_card_color.description: DVA card color: W (White), O (Orange), G (Gold)

data.description: Flat array of users in the organization. Only user_id and email are returned. The endpoint is not paginated and returns every user.

user_id.description: Parchment's unique identifier for the user

data.description: Full detail for a single user.

user_id.description: Parchment's unique identifier for the user

details.description: Identity fields. Sourced from the provider record when one exists, otherwise derived from the user record (date_of_birth and sex are then null).

provider_details.description: Provider record for the user. Present only when access_roles contains provider or rx_queue_manager. **null means the user has a provider role but no provider record, so the user cannot create prescriptions.**

erx_entity_id.description: eRx Entity ID (5 alphanumeric characters). Held on the user record.

family_name.description: Prescriber's family name as held on the provider record

given_name.description: Prescriber's given name as held on the provider record

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format

australian_address.description: Provider address. Only present when it has been set in the Parchment portal — the external API does not accept it.

UpdateUser.description: Fields to update. Send only the fields you want to change. access_roles and email are ignored — use the update-user-roles endpoint to change roles.

provider_details.description: Provider fields. Intended for a user with the provider or rx_queue_manager role, but the role is not checked. If the user has no provider record yet, sending this object creates one.

hpii_number.description: Healthcare Provider Individual Identifier (16 digits). Re-verified against the HI Service using hpii_number, given_name, family_name, date_of_birth and sex.

prescriber_number.description: Max 10 characters. Required when prescriber_type is not T.

erx_entity_id.description: eRx Entity ID — exactly 5 alphanumeric characters

code.description: Always SUCCESS. This endpoint does not return a provider result code. On a user with no provider record, HI Service lookup errors return 500 and a failed provider create is not reported — confirm with GET /users/{user_id}.

user_id.description: Parchment's unique identifier for the updated user
